items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: Because he was, matter of fact we stayed right next door to each other.

ctx.x: I was a little out of hand because I never got to there.

Because he was, matter of fact we stayed right next door to each other. You know he lived on one side of the house and I lived on the other side of the house. And there was always somebody playing on that piano from the day from morning until night. And there used to be quite a confusion about getting on the piano because he, his brother and his sister, all of them played.
Was that up on Liberty Street about?
